# Nunito Sans (the menus' typeface)

- Files: `android/app/src/main/assets/fonts/NunitoSans-VF.ttf` is `NunitoSans[YTLC,opsz,wdth,wght].ttf` renamed; `OFL.txt` here and, shipped with the font, `android/app/src/main/assets/licenses/NunitoSans-OFL.txt`.
- Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/8b0a1d0f5983c89bc2b93f1b5fb55f9e252744b5/ofl/nunitosans
  (commit 8b0a1d0f5983c89bc2b93f1b5fb55f9e252744b5), downloaded 2026-10-25 with the owner's approval.
- sha256: font `f934d7142fb4784bf828da485b7dcbd90c0c80d514e9d49a5da0ed3a1ae2491d`, OFL.txt
  `efbb0c9e864cef973982d9a17567e6be5c3d1759695574586f3f18c7ecca064b`.
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt). Shown in About > Licence Notices (FontNotice.java). The font is bundled with
  the app, never sold alone, and keeps its name.
- The variable font's default instance is weight 200: the apps set 'wght' 400 / 700 / 900 explicitly (UiKit.Faces).
